searchText: Got an initial doc about potential pectra-devnet-0: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/pectra-devnet-0 Could the different client teams please let me know what progress they have made so far? Currently I have a good idea about CL's progress, but no idea about ELs progress. 👀 - looking into it ⚒️ - working on it ✅ - implemented ❓ - no info of progress cc: <@&836981603216654336> <@&688101493978562687> hey <@412614104222531604> I can't edit it, but Nethermind status: 6110,7002 - working on it 2537 - implemented (possible that we will change library though) 7251 - it doesn't require changes on EL side, so it should be N/A for all ELs We have branches for 6110 and 7002, currently switching out the lib for 2537 as well https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/532 would this not require any change from the EL side ? good point, thx, so we have a small spec issue: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7251#execution-layer it says that it doesn't require changes on EL side we can update 7251 or do it in 7002 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7002#execution-layer we have implemented none so far, but have a tracking issue https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/issues/7363 Tracking issue for Nethermind: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/issues/6867 I'll let you decide that 😄 Happy to mark 7251 as N/A for EL, if you include the change in 7002 Tracking issue for Prysm: https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/issues/13849 alos yeah, 7251 needs a spec update if it actually does require engine changes I had no idea for many reasons (including facilitating independent syncing) we want to put all of the 7002 operations into the payload, so it won't change the Engine API in terms of new fields, it should only require updating the payload type
